description: The boundary as one GeoJSON Feature (application/geo+json, not wrapped in `data`), ready for MapLibre. properties: id, name, detail, dataset_version, attribution. Sent gzip-compressed when the client accepts gzip. A reply over 200 KB, or detail=full, is not inlined: the result is its REST URL and size, to download outside the chat. Needs an API key: the MCP client sends `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

detail.description: overview is for country and region maps, standard for a city view, full is the source geometry
